es.tpl.name: Revisión de contrato
es.tpl.description: Clasifica el contrato, revisa cláusulas y valora impacto económico y viabilidad en paralelo; luego resume riesgos y prepara observaciones sin enviarlas.
es.step.intake.title: Recibir y clasificar el contrato
es.step.intake.desc: Recibir el contrato con {{counterparty}}, identificar partes, vigencia, montos y tipo, y clasificarlo por urgencia.
es.step.legal_review.title: Revisión legal de cláusulas
es.step.legal_review.desc: Revisar responsabilidad, rescisión, confidencialidad y jurisdicción del contrato con {{counterparty}}.
es.step.economic_impact.title: Impacto económico
es.step.economic_impact.desc: Calcular pagos, penalizaciones y plazos de cobro del contrato con {{counterparty}} y su efecto en el margen.
es.step.operational_feasibility.title: Viabilidad operativa
es.step.operational_feasibility.desc: Verificar si la operación puede cumplir las obligaciones del contrato con {{counterparty}} en plazos y capacidad.
es.step.risk_summary.title: Resumen de riesgos y recomendación
es.step.risk_summary.desc: Resumir los riesgos legales, económicos y operativos con {{counterparty}} y recomendar aceptar, negociar o rechazar.
es.step.counterparty_notes.title: Observaciones para {{counterparty}}
es.step.counterparty_notes.desc: Preparar las observaciones para {{counterparty}} a partir de la revisión. No se envían sin aprobación.

en.tpl.name: Contract review
en.tpl.description: Classifies the contract, reviews clauses, and assesses economic impact and feasibility in parallel; then summarizes risks and prepares notes without sending them.
en.step.intake.title: Receive and classify the contract
en.step.intake.desc: Receive the contract with {{counterparty}}, identify parties, term, amounts and type, and classify it by urgency.
en.step.legal_review.title: Legal review of clauses
en.step.legal_review.desc: Review liability, termination, confidentiality and jurisdiction of the contract with {{counterparty}}.
en.step.economic_impact.title: Economic impact
en.step.economic_impact.desc: Calculate payments, penalties and collection terms of the contract with {{counterparty}} and their effect on margin.
en.step.operational_feasibility.title: Operational feasibility
en.step.operational_feasibility.desc: Check whether operations can meet the contract obligations with {{counterparty}} in terms of timing and capacity.
en.step.risk_summary.title: Risk summary and recommendation
en.step.risk_summary.desc: Summarize legal, economic and operational risks with {{counterparty}} and recommend accepting, negotiating or rejecting.
en.step.counterparty_notes.title: Notes for {{counterparty}}
en.step.counterparty_notes.desc: Prepare the notes for {{counterparty}} based on the review. Not sent without approval.
